title: hieracium onosmoides subsp. sphaerianthum
intro: Hieracium onosmoides subsp. sphaerianthum, commonly known as Sphaerianthus, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Sphaerianthus include analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-diarrheal effects, which can help alleviate pain, muscle spasms, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Sphaerianthus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
